ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters; estimated ratio of approximately 1:12 high-to-low intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark grey/black field covering >90% of visible surface. High-contrast white geometric clusters (linear and circular) are scattered across both lobes, with higher density of linear marks on the left lobe and circular marks on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with a vertex angle approximately 60-70 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 1/4 the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire boundary; amplitudes vary between 5-15 pixels, creating a jagged edge rather than a smooth arc.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple distinct white circular ring structures (approx. 5-10 visible) scattered across the mid-section of the right lobe and lower section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) primarily visible on the left lobe, ranging from short 20-pixel segments to longer diagonal marks spanning approximately 15% of the lobe width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distal tips of both lobes exhibit significant jagged tissue irregularity and erosion; right tip displays a distinct brownish-tan crustose texture contrasting with the black fluke skin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast brownish-yellow bio-fouling or necrotic tissue patch on the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
